(EN)정부초청+외국인+장학생+학사+운영+지침(2026.3.1.개정).p.text:
A GKS recipient must meet the part-time employment requirements set by the Ministry of Justice and other relevant authorities and comply with the following criteria:  
 1. A GKS recipient must prioritize studying their major program.  
 2. A GKS recipient in the Korean language program shall not engage in part-time employment until completing at least six (6) months of the program.  Part-time employment shall be permitted only during vacation periods.

3. A GKS recipient in a degree program may engage in part-time employment only where the president of the university grants approval upon determining that such employment does not significantly interfere with academic studies.  In making such determination, the president of the university shall comprehensively consider academic achievement, attendance records, and the opinion of the academic advisor.

5. The exception under Subparagraph 4 shall not apply to GKS recipients who have received two (2) academic warnings.  
 - ③ A GKS recipient in a degree program may engage in full-time employment if the recipient has satisfied the graduation requirements established by the university or if the recipient may maintain student status at the university after commencing employment.  
 - ④ A GKS recipient who engages in employment pursuant to Paragraph 3 and continues academic studies while maintaining student status at the university may retain GKS recipient status.

- **Article 24 (Management and Inspection of GKS recipient)** ① The NIIED president may conduct frequent or periodic inspections of the management status of GKS recipients at the Institution, and the Institution must actively cooperate by submitting relevant management documents and related materials.  
 - ② The president of the institution must manage part-time employment of GKS recipients to ensure sound academic progress and meaningful study in Korea.

(KO)정부초청+외국인+장학생+학사+운영+지침(2026.3.1.개정).p.text:
- ④제3항에 따라 취업한 장학생이 학업을 지속하고 수학대학의 학적을 유지하는 경우에는 장학생 자격을 유지할 수 있으며, 장학금 지급 여부는 학업 이행 여부, 학업 성취도 및 대학의 의견 등을 종합적으로 고려하여 결정한다. - ⑤교육원장은 정부초청 외국인 장학생(GKS) 사업의 성과 분석 및 동문 네트워크 구축을 위하여 관련 법령이 허용하는 범위 내에서 졸업생(동문)의 진로, 취업, 거주 국가 등 현황을 조사할 수 있다. - ⑥교육원장은 제5항에 따른 조사 수행을 위하여 필요한 경우, 관련 법령에 따라 수학대 학장에게 졸업생(동문) 조사에 필요한 정보 및 현황 자료 등을 요 청할 수 있다. 이 경 우 수학대학장은 특별한 사정이 없는 한 이에 협조하여야 한다. - 제25조(장학생 관리실적 평가) 교육원장은 수학기관에 대하여 장학생 관리실적을 평가하고, 그 결과를 수학대학 선정 및 장학생 인원 배정 등에 반영할 수 있다. **==> picture [53 x 12] intentionally omitted <==**

(EN)정부초청+외국인+장학생+학사+운영+지침(2026.3.1.개정).p.text: Part-time employment shall be permitted only during vacation periods.  Such employment shall require prior approval from the president of the Korean language institution and prior authorization from the Ministry of Justice.  Notwithstanding the foregoing, a recipient who has obtained the TOPIK level recognized by the president of the institution as necessary for advancement to a degree program may engage in part-time employment during the semester.  In such case, part-time employment shall not exceed twenty (20) hours per week.

provision applies only to the GKS recipient who has achieved 70% or higher of the passing score for the TOPIK level three (3).  
 - ⑤ A GKS recipient undergoing additional Korean language program as outlined in Paragraph 4 must bear fifty percent (50%) of the language training tuition as specified in the "Scholarship Payment Guideline" for GKS recipients by the National Institute for International Education.

## **Addenda**  
These regulations apply to all GKS recipients during the scholarship period as of March 1, 2026.  
- ※ These regulations for GKS recipients were originally written in Korean and translated into English. In the event of any conflict in interpretation, the Korean version of these regulations shall prevail.
